answer: Gate high-value work behind non-transferable capability tokens earned only through verified jobs. Each completed task mints one token, time-locked for several epochs, and a job requires a minimum token balance to bid. A fresh identity holds none, so a sybil farmer cannot wander into the lucrative grove of paid tasks with a thousand empty shells: every clone must first do real, checked work over many epochs to earn its tokens. Tokens cannot be bought or moved, and a failed audit burns them, so the only signal that buys access is a long, costly history of honest work.
